svg.title: Microsoft Foundry review architecture
svg.desc: Clients reach a planned API on Azure API Management. Outbound VNet integration connects APIM to private Foundry endpoints over peered virtual networks. The Foundry project hosts a coordinator and two specialist agents. A private virtual machine deploys agent versions. Dashed lines mark the unpublished client API path. Microsoft service icons are unmodified official Azure architecture assets.
svg.text: Private agent execution with an Azure API Management client entry point
AI Search and Log Analytics also support the platform.
Terraform provisions resources. CI validates code. The private runner publishes agent versions.
